ja.title: LLMによる0.016%の重みの編集でMATH-500が7.9%から48.1%になった報告は何を数えた値か。公開ログで読む
ja.summary: LLMによる0.016%の重みの編集でMATH-500が7.9%から48.1%になった報告を、公開ログで読み直した。差は500問の中で明確だが、基準は93%が長さ上限で打ち切られるモデルで、10回・25回・50回の予算は別々の編集の実行だった。
ja.seo_description: Weight-Space Programmingのブログ（Qwen3.5-0.8Bの0.016%の重みの編集でMATH-500が約6倍）を、公開ログのMATH-500の問題ごとの採点から、区間、打ち切りの割合、予算ごとの編集の違い、他のベンチマークとの関係で読み直した。
ja.seo_title: 0.016%の重みの編集の報告を読む

en.title: What does the reported rise in MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1% after an LLM edited 0.016% of the weights count? Reading it from the public logs
en.summary: A reported rise in MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1% after an LLM edited 0.016% of a model's weights was reread from the public logs. The difference is clear within 500 problems, but the baseline has 93% of samples cut at the length limit and the three budgets are separate runs with different edits.
en.seo_description: The Weight-Space Programming blog's claim (about 6x on MATH-500 from 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights) was reread from the public per-problem scores: intervals, share of cut-off outputs, the different edits behind each budget, and the relation to other benchmarks.
